rule: Let L0=mean(y^2), Lsure=threefold validation MSE of fold-trained SURE average, Vhat=max(L0-sigma^2,0). Use full-data SURE weights if L0-Lsure>0.25 Vhat; otherwise uniform weights. Known sigma. No signal-type-dependent decisions. Threshold and fallback selected from24rules on oldseed20261016, now frozen before new outcomes.
primary: 24 fixed cells, equally weighted. Success requires at least16/24 cell mean risk gains over CV3 greater than1e-10 AND one-sided95% paired-t lower bound of overall mean gain above0.001 MSE.32 independent banks, first average24cells withinbank,df31. This establishes empirical majority plus a positive global mean, NOT true superiority in a majority of cells.
cell_inference: Additionally show24 simultaneous one-sided Bonferroni t lower bounds, alpha0.05/24. Count positive lowerbounds; only >12 of these supports a majority-cell claim under approximate t assumptions. This is a separate inference family from overall primary; do not combine them into a single95%joint statement.
